subject: Re: Trueside - SIG-Lite, subprocessor inventory & evidence requests
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@trueside.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@trueside.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:11:00Z
Subject: Request: SIG-Lite + subprocessor inventory + dataflow (Trueside renewal)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding conversation earlier. As part of Trueside's renewal review and our internal third‑party risk process, we need the following from Redwood:  

1) Completed SIG‑Lite (or CAIQ) answers for the inference product scope.
2) A current subprocessor inventory (name, country, processing purpose, access description).
3) A high‑level dataflow diagram that shows where PHI/PII enters, which subprocessors see decrypted data, and any KMS usage.
4) Confirmation of SOC 2 scope & last report date (PDF if possible).

Can you provide the SIG‑Lite and the redacted subprocessor inventory by EOD Friday? Security will do a quick review and may follow up with clarifying questions. If you have a standard evidence bundle or past pack you can share, that will save us time.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior InfoSec Manager
Trueside Health

Attachments: None

Date: 2026-08-18T10:02:00Z

Forwarding Trueside's ask — they want SIG‑Lite, subproc list (redacted ok), dataflow, and SOC 2 PDF by EOD Fri.

Neha: can Security lead the SIG answers? We have a draft but it needs some gating on KMS details and what to redact for vendor contracts.
Camila: please confirm if redacting vendor contact emails is sufficient or if we should remove specific billing/contract IDs.
Jonas: can you pull the latest subprocessor CSV and a simple diagram (KMS + where caches are stored)?

I can assemble and send the bundle to Elena.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555‑0241

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG-Lite + subprocessor inventory + dataflow (Trueside renewal)

Thanks for the ping — I'll own the SIG‑Lite. Plan:

- Use the SIG‑Lite template and mark answers scoped to "Redwood hosted inference (generation + KV caching)".
- For subprocessor inventory, we will produce a redacted CSV with: Vendor name, country, processing purpose, high‑level data access (e.g., "ciphertext only", "decrypts for processing"), and contact role ("legal@" removed).
- For SOC 2: we can share the latest report PDF but need a signed NDA or an access agreement; for renewals they typically accept a secure link (we use a signed view link).

Jonas, can you attach: latest subprocessor export (anonymized columns) and a short diagram showing: ingestion → KMS‑decrypt step (edge), tokenization/cache, GPU serving (KV cache location), and logging flows (obfuscation applied). Mina: heads up — you might get a request for customer success context during renewal.

Target: draft SIG‑Lite + attachments ready by 2026‑08‑20 14:00 UTC. I'll run a quick internal redline pass.

Neha
Director, InfoSec
Redwood Inference

Attachments: None

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SIG-Lite + subprocessor inventory + dataflow (Trueside renewal)

Attached: redacted‑subprocessor‑inventory.csv and dataflow‑v2.pdf (high level). Notes:  

- CSV: removed email addresses and contract IDs; replaced with "contact_role" (e.g., Security, Legal, Billing). Column headers: vendor_name, country, purpose, access_level, contact_role, last_engagement_date.
- Dataflow: removed internal hostnames, included KMS box showing CMK in the cloud provider and where ephemeral keys are provisioned. PHI touchpoints highlighted in orange.

I left a few vendors flagged as "requires-contract-review" where we have sub‑processing clauses that differ (mainly around telemetry retention).

Attachments: redacted‑subprocessor‑inventory.csv (CSV), dataflow‑v2.pdf (PDF)

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@trueside.com>, Ethan Blake <procurement@trueside.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Trueside - SIG-Lite, subprocessor inventory & evidence requests

Hi Elena / Ethan — thank you for the summary and the timeline.  

Per our internal review, please find the attached evidence bundle:  
- sig-lite-answers.docx (SIG‑Lite scoped to Redwood hosted inference)
- redacted‑subprocessor‑inventory.csv (vendor name, country, purpose, access_level, contact_role)
- dataflow‑v2.pdf (high‑level dataflow with PHI touchpoint markers)

A few quick notes:  
- SOC 2: our most recent SOC 2 report is available via secure view. Please confirm if a signed NDA is required (we typically provide a limited access link to security contacts).
- Several vendors are flagged as "requires-contract-review" in the CSV; Camila is copied to coordinate any redlines.
- We removed vendor contact emails and internal hostnames from the diagram and CSV for confidentiality.

If you want, Neha can walk your security team through the SIG‑Lite answers on a 30‑minute call. We can also provide an export of telemetry retention settings for any vendor you flag.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether Trueside wants the SOC 2 link (NDA) or is ok proceeding with this bundle.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sig-lite-answers.docx (DOCX); redacted-subprocessor-inventory.csv (CSV); dataflow-v2.pdf (PDF)
